formulaBlock.normalization: No split entries; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) defining ether-sulfate anionic, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4); TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate (18) is a strong anionic but post-fragrance, so not a reinforcing route (C4). Sodium Xylenesulfonate (3) is a hydrotrope, not a route.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Late TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate and only one buffer argue toward strong, but C4 excludes the late sulfonate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful silicone-plus-guar deposition system, Dimethiconol (10), Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (11), Dimethicone (14). C2 not met: both silicones are post-fragrance (not early), no pearlizing/fatty route, Panthenol (19) only humectant.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Two silicones plus a cationic guar is a deliberate 2-in-1 coacervate architecture that can give substantial slip (neighbor high).

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: a persistent silicone system (Dimethiconol 10, Dimethicone 14) converges with a cationic guar (11), so residue is plausible; no lipid, film or protein reinforces it and a buffered SLES chassis gives ordinary reset.

depositionLoad.rationale: Two silicones plus guar, designed for deposition, at post-fragrance levels.

persistence.rationale: Silicones (especially dimethicone) can persist and accumulate with repeated use.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES + betaine; hydrotrope and late sulfonate add little.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: One persistent silicone/guar system gives noticeable but bounded residue; no rich architecture, ordinary reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: no W-RICH, no third converging family, effective SLES chassis; not low: W1 does not apply (no amodimethicone) and two families including persistent silicones make 'lightweight' an understatement (W2).
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Silicone level unknown; silicone+guar coacervate deposition could be stronger (neighbor high by the N-ALT heavier tie-break).

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Recognized active Piroctone Olamine (6) and Menthol (12); scalp_active needs a dandruff claim. Lengths care-direction: nonspecific (silicone/guar generic conditioning).

usageRole.rationale: Default; treatment possible with a qualifying dandruff claim (U3).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: CSA formula half NOT met: no prominent E4 comfort or humectant route (Panthenol 19 and Niacinamide 30 are post-fragrance). Menthol (12) post-fragrance cooling signal.
